Malachar.name: Malachar Embervein
Malachar.innate: Arcane Overload — Once per Round, after you play an Attack card that costs 2 or more Actions, you may Overload it. That Attack gains +2 Attack. After it resolves, Malachar suffers 1 damage.

Garruk.name: Garruk Stoneblood
Garruk.innate: Bloodrage — Once per Round, after Garruk suffers damage, his next Attack this Round gains +2 Attack.

Veyra.name: Veyra Duskwhisper
Veyra.innate: Malefic Hex — Once per Round after Veyra applies a harmful Status Effect to an Enemy, her next Attack against that Enemy this Round gains +2 Attack.

Mordren.name: Mordren Graveshade
Mordren.innate: Raise Servant — Once per Round after an Enemy in Mordren's Location is defeated, place 1 Bone Servant token in that Location, maximum 1.

Lucien.name: Lucien Valestrike
Lucien.innate: Duelist's Tempo — Once per Round after Lucien Moves, his next melee Attack that turn gains +1 Attack.

Asha.name: Asha Spiritwalker
Asha.innate: Spirit Guide — Once per Round after Asha applies a Status Effect to a Hero or Enemy in her Location, choose one Hero there. That Hero may draw 1 card, then discard 1 card. Totemic Presence — Asha may have 1 Spirit Totem in play.
